name: Connection quality
formula: round(100 * successRatio * (0.7 + 0.2 * max(0, 1 - meanHttpsMs/1000) + 0.1 * max(0, 1 - meanAdjacentJitterMs/200)))
description: Operational quality of three HTTPS echo requests, not reputation. TCP latency and optional 3 MB download are independent measurements. Trust is separately 100 minus proxycheck v3 detections.risk.
